paragraphs: We recommend using both ISA allowances for the new tax year and making pension contributions into both SIPPs up to the appropriate level. {marker:sipp_contribution_amounts}
We recommend adding to the Holloway joint GIA. {marker:gia_addition_amount}
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly held investment account. {marker:new_account_balance}
We recommend disinvesting a portion of the Holloway joint GIA and rebalancing it. {marker:gia_portion_sold}
We recommend leaving the other investment as it is for now and revisiting it at the next review.
